en: A Petition of Great Compassion, A Petition of Great Compassion: According to the sutras, those who wish to receive and uphold [this practice] should first, with a sincere mind, recite the name of Amitābha Buddha three times. One should take as their object of focus that Amitābha Buddha is the original teacher of Avalokiteśvara.
I look up in reverence to Avalokiteśvara of the Moon Disk, Whose vast and perfect body is of purple-gold.
With a thousand arms constantly extended throughout the world, And a thousand eyes whose radiance shines everywhere,
He possesses one thousand two hundred mantra-seals, Capable of fulfilling the hearts' desires of all sentient beings.
With three eyes adorning his face in full splendor, he bears Amitābha upon his crown and holds a precious vessel.
Proclaiming the subtle Dharma of mantras, those who receive and uphold them shall realize the Bodhi of the Buddhas.
With unimpeded eloquence, he transforms humans and devas, serving as the foremost leader among the assembly of Bodhisattvas.
Hearing it but briefly still extinguishes karma as numerous as the sands of the Ganges; Reciting and contemplating it only increases the causes for attaining Buddhahood.
The power of the Great Compassionate Vow is inconceivable; Therefore, I now constantly praise and recite:
Namo Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara. May I swiftly come to know all dharmas.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I quickly obtain the eye of wisdom.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I swiftly deliver all sentient beings.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I quickly obtain skillful means.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara: May I swiftly board the ship of Prajñā.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara: May I soon cross over the sea of suffering.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara: May I swiftly attain the path of precepts and meditative concentration.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I quickly ascend the mountain of Nirvana.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I swiftly reach the abode of the unconditioned.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara; May I soon become one with the Dharma-nature body.
If I approach the Mountain of Blades, the mountain of blades shall naturally crumble; if I approach the Boiling Cauldron, the boiling cauldron shall naturally vanish;
if I approach Hell, hell shall naturally wither and parch; if I approach the realm of Hungry Ghosts, the hungry ghosts shall naturally be satiated;
if I approach the Asuras, their evil minds shall naturally be subdued; if I approach the realm of Animals, they shall naturally attain great wisdom.
The Divine and Wondrous Verses of the Great Compassionate Heart Dhāraṇī of the Thousand-Handed and Thousand-Eyed Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Vast, Perfect, and Unobstructed.
The Divine and Wondrous Verses of the Great Compassionate Heart Dhāraṇī of the Thousand-Handed and Thousand-Eyed Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Vast, Perfect, and Unobstructed. Namo Hara-tana-ta-ra.
Namo āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya oṃ sara-paya suta-tathāgata-namas-sugata.

We and all sentient beings together shall attain the path of Buddhahood.
